gloss: to be absorbed in; to be engrossed in; to be passionate about

definitions.gloss: to be absorbed in; to be engrossed in; to be passionate about
definitions.explanation: To devote oneself wholeheartedly to an activity, losing awareness of other things.

examples.japanese: {読書|どくしょ}に{熱中|ねっちゅう}する。
{子供|こども}たちはゲームに{熱中|ねっちゅう}している。
examples.english: The children are engrossed in a game.

examples.japanese: {仕事|しごと}に{熱中|ねっちゅう}するあまり、{食事|しょくじ}を{忘|わす}れてしまった。
examples.english: I was so absorbed in my work that I forgot to eat.

notes:
A する verb meaning to become completely absorbed in something. Takes the particle に to mark the object of absorption. Composed of {熱|ねつ} (heat/fever) + {中|ちゅう} (in the middle of), suggesting being 'in the heat' of an activity.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {仕事|しごと}に{熱中|ねっちゅう}する: to be absorbed in work
- ゲームに{熱中|ねっちゅう}する: to be engrossed in a game
- {研究|けんきゅう}に{熱中|ねっちゅう}する: to be devoted to research
- {熱中|ねっちゅう}するあまり: so absorbed that...

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {夢中|むちゅう}になる: to be crazy about — slightly more informal; emphasizes loss of self-awareness
- {没頭|ぼっとう}する: to immerse oneself — more formal; emphasizes deliberate deep concentration
- はまる: to get hooked on — casual; often used for hobbies, entertainment

RELATED WORDS:
{熱中症|ねっちゅうしょう} (heatstroke) uses the same {熱中|ねっちゅう} characters but has a completely different meaning.
